title: ウチナーヤマトグチ 合成音声 ネイティブ確認セット（約100発話）

selection.rule: Reuse already-synthesized Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS. Take 13 complete 8-turn conversations (104 utterances, not mid-cut) so reviewers hear full dialogues. Always include the 8 conversations that already have both phonetic and orthographic audio. Add 5 more: 3 relatively dialect-dense (qnov05-001/004/038) and both reserved dev conversations (qnov05-035/039).
selection.voices: A/B roles use fixed Gemini voices from the 2026-11-05 synthesis plan (Kore/Puck and other pairs).
selection.phonetic_condition: Synthesized from the manually specified spoken kana.
selection.orthographic_condition: Synthesized from the written text as-is, same voice and style, for 8 conversations only.
selection.not_gold: Scripts are fictional colloquial Uchinaa Yamatoguchi with peer-reviewed manual readings, not native-verified. Judgments from this pack must not be used as training targets unless separately approved.
selection.review_audio_format: MP3 64 kbps / 24 kHz mono, transcoded from the original WAV for a smaller review pack. Original WAVs remain on the GPU at experiments/uchina-native-synth-review-20261110/audio and the 2026-11-05 source directories.
